newsitem.title: GERMANY: German sugar beet harvest runs ahead of last year.
newsitem.headline: German sugar beet harvest runs ahead of last year.

text.p: German sugar beet deliveries to refineries up to October 25 were 10.76 million tonnes, up from 10.49 million the same time last year, sugar industry association WVZ said in its fifth report of the 1996/97 campaign.
Sugar content at delivery on Oct 25 was 17.95 percent, up from 16.66 percent a year earlier.
WVZ maintained its forecast for final deliveries of 26.43 million tonnes, up from a final 26.05 million in 95/96.
WVZ will run delivery updates until the end of the campaign in January on a weekly basis.
Deliveries to refineries up to Oct 18 were 8.52 million tonnes versus 8.03 million at the same time last year and sugar content then was 17.88 percent, up from 16.54 percent previously.
